newsitem.title: USA: NorAm seeks U.S. FERC approval of merger.
newsitem.headline: NorAm seeks U.S. FERC approval of merger.

text.p: NorAm Energy Corp on Thursday said it sought federal regulatory approval for its merger with Houston Industries Inc.
NorAm said its NorAm Energy Services subsidiary filed a formal merger application with the U.S. Federal Energy Regulatory Commission and asked for an expedited review of the deal.
The Houston-based companies earlier said the federal agency has no jurisdiction over the deal, but sought approval anyway to avoid delays in completing the merger, they said.

"Even though we still believe that the FERC does not have jurisdiction over the merger, our primary goal is to complete the merger as quickly as possible," Don Jordan, Houston Industries chairman, said.
The merger has been approved by the five states and Texas municipalities, and the Justice Department has completed its review of the deal, the companies said.
The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission is still reviewing Houston Industries' application for a public utility holding company exemption, they said.
